name: Mistake x Miscast
source:
This is the debut title for Mignonne. Itsuki occasionally has dreams about a lover from his past life, Suou-hime. One morning in homeroom, a new transfer student named Rin who looks just like her appeared in front of his very eyes and he embraced her, happy that he finally met her again. “What are you suddenly hugging me for… What’s wrong with you?” Well, it’s natural that he would get hit after that doing that to someone who he met for the first time. However, that isn’t what shocked him the most. It was that the cute Suou-hime that he knew was now a tomboy. Meanwhile, her twin older sister Yui, his osananajimi Kuu and the rest of the class watched dumbfoundedly.

[From [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2012/09/01/september-2012-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
本作是Mignonne的出道作品。篠原壱树偶尔会梦见前世的恋人苏芳姬。某天早上的班会课上，一名与她长得一模一样的转学生苏芳轮出现在眼前，壱树欣喜若狂，以为终于重逢，立刻抱住了她。“你为什么突然抱我……你有毛病吗？”第一次见面就做出这种事，挨打当然不足为奇。然而最令他震惊的还不是这一点，而是记忆中可爱的苏芳姬如今竟成了假小子。与此同时，轮的双胞胎姐姐苏芳结、壱树的青梅竹马望月久优，以及班上其他同学都目瞪口呆地看着这一幕。

[译自 [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2012/09/01/september-2012-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
